description: Look up any US building by its street address and get the public data SPACEXPLORATION keeps on it, whether or not it is for sale or lease: the FEMA flood zone and natural hazard risk, EPA records nearby (including leaking underground storage tanks), Census demographics around it, access and nearby amenities, and, where research has found it, the county public record (owner, assessed and market values, taxes, tax lots, recorded sales) with a numbered source for each figure. Also returns the building page URL to share and any live listings in it (pass a listing hashid to get_listing). The first lookup of a building gathers its data in the background, which takes a minute or two, and researches its county record, which can take several minutes: while status.gathering or status.researching_county_record is true, check on it with get_parcel and the returned hashid instead of repeating the lookup. Requires a signed-in account.

address.description: A full US street address with its street number, e.g. "910 Elysian Fields Ave, New Orleans, LA 70117". A road, a town or a partial address is refused: the lookup has to name one building.

name: look_up_parcel
title: Look up a building
